acceptanceCriteria: A spec (domain spec, not the leases spec) defines one retention story: prefix-seal or fresh-store, with its audit root, chain-hash continuity, terminal-only eligibility, and a rollback via archive restore.

The implemented path drops a verified, all-terminal prefix (or migrates to a fresh store) and the audit runs from the checkpoint; tamper tests on the archived prefix and on the retained checkpoint refuse.
A measured before/after on a synthetic store of at least 40k receipts shows complete-route audit time and store bytes, retained in the build log.
doctor reports journal size and growth rate with a threshold finding.
receipt compact help states what it reclaims (liveness bodies only) and points to the retention path.
body: GitHub #1055, a follow-up to #982, V1-1508 and V1-1511. On one long-running queue: 47,136 receipts, 493 MB, 19 days old; 84% are TRANSITION receipts averaging about 9 KB. `receipt compact --dry-run` elides 8,848 receipts, shrinking 424.7 MB to 382.2 MB (about 10%). Most of the store is the history of settled tickets and attempts, which can never change again. Every complete-route audit and every cold start still walks it, and that feeds the pool-acquire starvation behind #1010 and V1-1617. The reporter's asks: (1) a supported way to drop an archived, verified prefix whose tickets are all terminal from the live store, keeping its chain hash and checkpoint and auditing from that checkpoint onward (archive export/verify/restore already exist); or (2) a documented fresh-store-from-snapshot path that carries forward only live tickets, leases and policy and keeps the old store read-only; (3) doctor reports journal size and growth rate with a threshold warning; (4) `receipt compact` help states the typical share it can reclaim. The store format is one-way after compaction, so the reporter wants a single documented retention story. This changes store authority and audit roots, so spec it first; the one-way migration needs a documented rollback (a retained archive plus restore).
title: corvint-tasks journal retention: retire settled ticket/attempt history from the live journal (sealed verified prefix or fresh store from snapshot), doctor size/growth warning, compact help expectations (GitHub #1055)
